title: Slider
text: Tune parameter value with sliding scale, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the block parameter value to connect parameter value connection, {Scale Type} sets the type of scale, {Minimum}, {Maximum} and {Tick Interval} sets the interval between major tick marks. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Block parameter value to connect parameter value connection options

params.name: Tick Interval
params.values: Interval between major tick marks auto (default) | scalar

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Top (default) | Bottom | Hide
